exposure: additional counseling during informed consent for unplanned cesarean birth
standard informed consent for unplanned cesarean birth
outcome: patient satisfaction (communication, mistrust, fear of OR, loss of control)
finding: There was no statistical difference in patient satisfaction between those receiving additional counseling and those receiving standard informed consent, but both groups showed significantly higher levels of birth satisfaction than present in prior research.
mod_finding: Training residents to discuss communication, fear, mistrust, and loss of control during informed consent for unplanned cesarean birth may have improved patient satisfaction for all participants.
